svg.title: One flow, two typed questions, two typed answers. is_attack, a noul question, returns 0.80, above the 0.58 cut, so the verdict is attack. category, a choice question, returns DoS with confidence 0.89 and the probabilities DoS 0.91, BENIGN 0.08, Botnet 0.01, DDoS 0.00, PortScan 0.00 and BruteForce 0.00. The flow is the first of the zero-day DoS Slowhttptest burst of CIC-IDS2017, judged with labels 200 flows late.
